Congressman, I know in a few weeks you're planning to introduce some immigration-related legislation. Is it too early to give us a preview of that or can you let us know what you're thinking there?

No, Greg, I appreciate you giving me an opportunity to talk about that. It's not immigration, because if we talk immigration up here, it's like Moses parting the seas. One side goes one way, one goes the other way. One gets accused of giving. Everybody amnesty, and the other one gets accused of deportating. So we've changed the narrative. It's a guest worker program for the lower skilled ag hospitality construction. Briefly on the ag side. It gives a portal for people to come into this country. They're pre-screened before they come in. A job is already available once they get accepted and approved by DHS. USDA would run this. They're here for five years at a time and they can follow a crop around the United States. They can renew four and a half years into it. There is no pathway to citizenship. It gives them the right to come here and work. They can also go back and forth to their host country. We're working with the countries of origin of these people so that they're verifying these people are who they are. And we also take that group of people that have come in illegally to where they can apply to this program. Background checks would be run. There will be a fee of $2,500. And then if they qualify for the program, they can enter into it. And the unique thing about our bill is you apply for a guest worker program for agriculture or hospitality or construction. you're indebted to that sector. So it's either you work agriculture for five years. And if you leave that one and get caught working in one of the other ones, you've broken your commitment. And so that permit gets removed. And this will keep people honest in the profession that they said they wanted to work in. And it would clear up, it would solve about 90% of our illegal immigration. And so we can fix immigration, but focused on a guest worker program for AG hospitality and construction.
